reviews.comment: Uppity sweet soul, grandma teaching stats sorta vibes. I would take this again and again. Stats can be a bit difficult but much better type of math than calculus...

A whimsical kinda gal that was really passionate about stats and would sometimes go on tangents. I didn't find the class hard, but I had already taken a stats class before. I imagine it would probably be difficult to follow along if I hadn't though. There was a lot of practice material and resources if you ever got stuck. Not a lot of work overall.

The class itself is made up of common exams. Class was entertaining but didn't learn much. I learned most when doing the homework myself. In my opinion, she isn't the best professor but she is passionate about statistics.

She was great! The lectures and notes were easy to understand. She was always available and very helpful with any questions and concerns. Tests were online and weren't overly difficult. She even offered different times to take the final exam based on your preference which was awesome. Overall a very good experience and I would recommend.

Dr. K is extremely kind and wants each of her students to do well. She talks and writes EXTREMELY fast. I often couldn't listen because I was just trying to catch up with her. She is fs one of the harder professors for this class, as people I know in other classes got cheat sheets on the tests and we did not. Maybe take a diff prof if you can.

very sporadic while lecturing, kinda just rambles on & on at times. 2 midterms that make up 70% of your grade. use the homework to boost your grade cause failing one exam is basically the end of your grade. lecture is boring but she's nice. takes forever to respond to emails tho.

She's annoying and never responds to emails. I learned more on my own. Homework is long and pointless; tests make up so much of your grade. Just do the homework to boost your grade, and the Canvas practice exam like 10 times. She's nice though and approachable, just such a sporadic teacher couldnt follow along.
Honestly she was alright, her final was ridiculous (D average even with cheat sheet she let us have), didn't feel like I learned much from lecture. Practice exams in Canvas I found helpful.

Lecture is lethally boring, notes not posted. No textbook or online resources. Pop quizzes. Many students skipped lecture regardless. Homework is tedious and frustrating but you basically get ∞ attempts. 4 exams == 80% of grade. Cheat sheets on exams. Similar to practice exam.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: reviews and homework were not helpful for the midterms and the final. tests also made up 70% of your grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Will do great in the class until the mid terms and finals. They are not like the reviews and are very hard. I recommend not taking her and taking a different professor. Also, does not respond to emails.
One of the best profs I had this semester. Clear notes and practice exams. Homework was tedious but prepares you well with the material. If you can do the homework, the tests are a breeze. TAKE HER!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. K is a good prof who has a real passion for stats. Her lectures/notes are alright, but the course itself is pretty easy. The hardest part is figuring out some of the coding in R, but it's all really basic and google-able. She provides lots of ways to receive help on homework and really does care about her students. Exams are multiple choice.
Confused by the low rating, I suspect it is because she doesn't post lecture notes because she wants people to come to class. Lectures are recorded and you can get the notes that way.

Never been more confused by a low rating on a professor. Probably one of the most enthusiastic lecturers I have ever come across and tests are fairly easy. Notes not being posted online can be frustrating but is understandable as she wants people to come to class.

Good Prof, assigns too much homework. Tests are MC but difficult if you arent familiar with at least the theory. Shes excellent at explaining and incredibly smart, but is the hardest stats prof. I finished with an 89 that didnt get rounded up to an A, but shes a tough professor in a tough class. You really need to learn the material to pass.

She is not helpful at all. She fills in notes on a word processor during lecture and posts her unfilled in notes, which are not helpful at all. She also moves at the speed of light so taking notes on paper is impossible. When asking her to post her filled in notes to help study for the exam she said no because people dont come to class.

Her exams were MC. Her notes were useful during her lecture which you must attend. I sometimes explained things to the class better than she (imo, subjective). Her exams were tough. I made 79.1% in her course or somewhere very close to it. She bumped me to a B, I think bc she saw I had an understanding (I spoke a lot). Understand material - do well
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Due to switching online, this class was hard to focus on but Dr. K really went out of her way to make sure we understood everything. Do the homework!!! You only have 2 exams and the final and the rest is up to the homework and can help your grade! If you study 4 days before the exam and understand the concepts, you'll do well. She's quirky but good

Here's how you can do well. Go to Tutor John before exams, do all online homework, go to every class for participation points. She moves kinda fast through the material, so a lot of what you find on exams you can learn about during Tutor John sessions. Expect to dedicate time to this class if you want a good grade. The prof is extremely nice.

She may not be the easiest statistics teacher, but I really enjoyed her class. She is super nice and you can tell she cares a lot about teaching and statistics. I learned a lot of useful stuff. The material is challenging, but I personally never felt too overwhelmed. She lets you use a cheatsheet on tests!

Her tests are made to be as hard as possible. She hardly answer questions, and if she does they are bad confusing answers. She assigns about 31-40 hw Qs per week while other profs only give 15. Lecture is not at all helpful beyond the first test (tutor john>). Her test averages are below 65s and the curve doesn't help out B students only D and Cs

This is the hardest class I have ever taken. I went to class but didnt help cause I never understand anything she was saying. She gives twice the amount of hw as the other profs and her tests are BRUTAL. She is a sweet lady whos really smart, but it seems like she makes everything as difficult as possible even though she would probably disagree.

I took this required class and it was literally hell. I went to class only for the in class participation points but other than that I played on my phone because there was no point in listening. She is cruel with her homework and gives you twice the amount of other profs. Her tests are incredibly hard. Tutor John is the reason I passed.

She's quite nice but sometimes it's hard to understand what she's trying to say. I feel like the lectures didn't flow - they were a bit choppy. She should try drawing more things on the board or screen. I read the book, hired a private tutor, and studied hard for an A.

Seriously amazing! She is so funny and cares about her students. There are two tests and then the final, and you get a cheat sheet for each. She does a great job at teaching and there is a lot of homework but it's very helpful and you can ask her questions about it. She doesn't post notes though so if you miss class make sure you have a friend.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. K was a wonderful person. She had a very enthusiastic and exciting personality, and really cared about the students. However, she gives a lot of homework, has very difficult exams, and makes a lot of mistakes in lectures, which are very confusing and disorganized. There are a lot of easier stat profs to take as an alternative.

Don't get me wrong, Dr. K is a good professor - she explains topics very well, is extremely caring and kind, and she puts a lot of effort into her office hours. However, compared to other stats classes, her tests are significantly harder and she gives A LOT more homework. If you really want to learn stats, take Dr. K. If not, take someone else.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She's a nice person, really sweet. But her exams are so damn difficult. I believe the other stat professors have much higher exam averages than her by at least 15-20 points. She intentionally makes stats harder than it should be by trying to confuse you. She also gives the most homework out of the other professors, its pretty long. Don't recommend.

I've taken stats before in HS and she was WAY better than my old teacher. Has fill in the blank notes that are very helpful and structure her lectures (which means the book is optional). Only 2 midterms so they span about 10 CH each, but they're not too bad bc she allows a cheat sheet. Extremely fair grader who tries to give back as many points
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. K is one of the best teachers I have ever had at A&M. I am horrible at math, I am a science girl and once again I AM HORRIBLE AT MATH. like I made a C in intro math 141 freshman year. But somehow I am made an A in stats, and its all bc of Dr. k. However, stats is a very tough class and I worked my butt off for that A so don't let that fool u!

She's fair. I didn't really enjoy her teaching style, but her fill in notes are super helpful & explain it well. She grades super easy, she gives partial credit on the MC exams, drops homework & clickers to help your grade. She also alters the letter cut off grade for the curve. I didn't enjoy her lecture, but really good/fair prof overall.

i HATED statistics before this class. Dr. K is by far the BEST prof for stat 302 but that doesn't mean the class is easy. She drops your lowest homework grades and does all she can to help you and keep the class interesting even though it is a tougher subject.
Be ready to go to tutoring. Terrible notes, easily confuses her self, and is the only prof that doesn't allow graphing calculators. Do yourself a favor and avoid at all costs

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. Her notes are a mess, her lectures are difficult to follow, and her test are from hell. All other stat 302 profs let you use a graphing calculator - she doesn't and it makes a huge difference. She never responds to emails and her homeworks are 40 questions long. run while you can.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: This professor was super sweet and fun and made lectures go by quickly.  She explains the material very well. Gives really good practice tests before each exam.  Helps with homework questions in class at least once a week.  Definitely not an easy subject but she is approachable and so helpful!

she explains things really well but I read the text for more in depth explanation. Her notes that you print of and fill in during lecture are all you need to study for the exams. Has clicker quiz for every lecture. She gave extra points on an exam where the average was low and she drops lowest HW grades. I had an 89.3 and she gave me the A.

Dr. Kolodziej is one of the most amazing professors I have ever had.  I am shocked by the low reviews on this site. The class content is very tough. However, the Q&A sessions were extremely clear and helpful. I found her to be very knowledgeable. I can't wait to take her 608 class in the Spring!!!!

Another professors lectures were used. Personally I am not a fan of that set up but I understand that was not her fault. However, she did not know the material she was teaching and made the homework really confusing. What was worse is it was over the summer so it was accelerated. I didn't learn a thing I was too busy trying to just keep up. AVOID!
Dont take her. Does not teach at all

Prof simply doesn't engage the student with insightful or concise information. Bubbly personality but no real teaching was ever given. Struggled the while semester without ever once feeling like she was truly helpful.
